description: Stage-8 selected precision policy of GLM-5.3-Flash (E192) on p300x2 TP4 (combo_a_kv_dense4_g4): the stage-7 policy (optimized_decoder.SELECTED = opt_s5_pf, multichip_decoder.DEFAULT_MC) plus the overrides below. Consumed by tt/precision.PrecisionOverrides (GLM53_PRECISION unset = this file; GLM53_PRECISION=none = the stage-7 policy).

base.multichip_decoder.DEFAULT_MC: stage-5 default of commit 9fcc17c0dc4 (incl. sinkhorn_faces, dsa_q_mm, dsa_q_mm_ib=64, dsa_tail_shared, kda_conv_max_batch=16; ag_persistent=False)
base.measured_on: selection: 3-reference reselection on git archive 9fcc17c0dc4 (logits-pad fix) + tt/precision.py (HEAD + the stage-8 review-3 hunks), runs/*_h9 (the reselection) and runs/final_default_h9 (GLM53_PRECISION unset)

policy.layer_range_note: 'inner' = layers 1-43 for KDA / DSA / shared expert; the dense MLP is bfp4 on layers 1-2 (layer 0 keeps bfp8); the first layer 0 and the last layer 44 keep bfp8 KDA projections and shared expert. combo_a_all (bfp4 also on layers 0 / 44) gives min top-1 89 on the fixed code (prefill check p2): rejected

dsa_q_a_kv_a_pack_q_b_o_proj.dtype: bfp4 (all 11 DSA layers: 3, 7, ..., 43; none is the first / last layer)

policy.activations_residual: bf16 residual streams (4 mHC streams, hidden-sharded over TP4); fp32 mHC mix partials
policy.ccl: bf16 all-gathers / reduce-scatters of the residual (bfp8 CCL rejected: +0.47 ms); fp32 all-gather of mHC mix partials

kv_cache.dsa_latent_pool: fp8_e4m3 ROW_MAJOR rows (sparse_sdpa kv_format FP8_E4M3), 512 B per token per DSA layer
kv_cache.dsa_indexer_pool_keys: bf16 TILE, 64 B per token per DSA layer
kv_cache.block_sharded_cache: GLM53_DSA_SHARD=1 keeps a bf16 latent (fp8 not implemented for tt/dsa_shard.py); warning logged

policy.logits_sampling: LM head bfp4 x bf16 activations, LoFi, fp32 accumulate; bf16 logits; on-device split greedy / top-k sampler unchanged
policy.moe_routing: sigmoid router bf16 weights HiFi4, bias + top-8 on device, routed_scaling 2.5 (unchanged)

runtime_flags.GLM53_PRECISION: unset = this file; 'none' = stage-7 policy; <path> = another candidate

policy.decode_specs_note: bfp4-tuned decode programs (geometry/summary.json; tools/mc_matmul_sweep.py --wdtype bfp4 --fidelity LoFi) on the layers where each group is bfp4; DEFAULT_MC itself is unchanged. On combo_a_kv weights the same programs (all, or all but kda_in) shift p2 teacher forcing to 89 % on the fixed code; with the dense-MLP bfp4 weights they pass
